title: PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication
abstract: arXiv:2610.02072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). translated_title: PyPottery：一个AI驱动的陶器处理与发表端到端套件
translated_abstract: 陶质材料的研究是考古学研究的基石，然而陶器记录的后期制作流程仍然耗费大量人力，并造成严重的发表瓶颈。本文提出了PyPottery，一个开源、AI驱动的套件，旨在将完整的陶器记录流程半自动化。该套件包含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan用于自动图像提取和手写识别；PyPotteryInk用于铅笔图纸的自动上墨；PyPotteryTrace用于具备语义感知的矢量化；以及PyPotteryLayout用于自动版面生成。该框架在来自意大利Terramara di Montale遗址的50张手绘图纸（包含240幅陶器绘图）上进行了评估，实现了显著的时间节省，可用性研究的参与者也证实了这一点，他们报告相比传统工作流程的中位感知加速比为40倍（范围：17.5倍至120倍）。
tldr: PyPottery是一个开源AI套件，通过图像提取、自动上墨、语义矢量化与版面生成四个集成模块，将陶器考古记录的完整流程半自动化，使工作效率相比传统方法提升约40倍。
en_tdlr: PyPottery is an open-source AI-powered suite that semi-automates the entire pottery documentation pipeline through four integrated modules—image extraction with handwriting recognition, automatic inking, semantic vectorization, and layout generation—achieving a perceived 40× speedup over traditional workflows.
